description: This file provides core asynchronous workflow logic functions for managing approval workflows, including starting workflows, progressing steps, applying approvals, and handling step approvers. It interacts with database models and CRUD operations to manipulate workflow instances, steps, and approvers.

methods.name: _get_step_approvers_from_config(step_config)
methods.description: Retrieve approver list from step config JSON.

methods.name: _get_any_one_can_approve_flag(step_config)
methods.description: Determine if 'any_one_can_approve' flag is set in step config JSON.

methods.name: _create_instance_step_approvers(db, step, step_config)
methods.description: Create approver assignment records for a step when it moves to IN_PROGRESS.

methods.name: None start_workflow(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Initialize and start a workflow instance, setting first steps to IN_PROGRESS and creating approver assignments.

methods.name: None proceed_to_next_step(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Advance the workflow to the next step(s), checking approval statuses, updating instance status if completed.

methods.name: None apply_approval( db: AsyncSession, instance_step_id: int, approver_action: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, comments: Optional[str] = None, approver_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Process an approval or rejection action from an approver, update approver record, and trigger progression if conditions are met.

ctags.name: apply_approval
ctags.signature: ( db: AsyncSession, instance_step_id: int, approver_action: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, comments: Optional[str] = None, approver_id: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: proceed_to_next_step
ctags.pattern: /^async def proceed_to_next_step(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int) -> None:$/

ctags.pattern: /^async def start_workflow(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int) -> None:$/
